brand.name: Praxis Development (Pty) Ltd
brand.description: Pan-African boutique consultancy specialising in evidence-based organisational development, leadership, strategic transformation and institutional resilience.
brand.aboutIntro: Praxis Development is a pan-African boutique consultancy. By blending psychology, innovation and social sciences, we refine the strategies, structures and processes that help organisations adapt and thrive.
brand.mission: To spark sustainable development by transforming organisational structures, cultures and skills—empowering institutions to confidently navigate complexity and crisis.
brand.vision: To cultivate a resilient landscape of African organisations and leaders who deliver high-impact social and economic outcomes, fostering sustainable development and elevating the quality of life across communities they serve.

faqs.question: What does Praxis Development specialise in?
faqs.answer: We work in evidence-based organisational development, including diagnostics, strategy and structure, change management, leadership development, operational excellence and capacity building.

faqs.question: Which organisations do you work with?
faqs.answer: Our services are tailored for NGOs and community organisations, donor agencies, governments, philanthropic foundations, and international organisations, as well as private-sector clients.

faqs.question: Can training be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. Praxis offers high-impact, on-demand training programmes tailored to the goals and context of each organisation.

faqs.question: What is the Ubuntu-Science approach?
faqs.answer: We combine rigorous research and organisational diagnosis with inclusive, human-centred implementation grounded in Ubuntu.

faqs.question: Where is Praxis Development based?
faqs.answer: Praxis Development is based in Johannesburg, South Africa, and describes its work as pan-African.

faqs.question: How do we start an engagement?
faqs.answer: Call our Johannesburg contact number or prepare an enquiry through the website to discuss your organisational needs and next steps.

team.name: Thami Sonile
team.bio: Founder of Praxis Development and an award, grants and compliance strategist with over two decades of experience across African development programmes. Thami has managed development portfolios exceeding US$170 million and held regional roles with TechnoServe, DAI Global, Chemonics International and FHI360.

team.name: Bwalya Mwelwa
team.bio: Bwalya leads the firm’s day-to-day operations, bringing more than five years of public administration and corporate experience across southern Africa. Her work spans cross-functional teams, market activation, logistics, client relations and digital stakeholder engagement.
expertise: Digital stakeholder engagement and client care
Market analysis, logistics and database management

team.name: Lifutso Motsieloa (PhD)
team.bio: Public health strategist with over 20 years of experience across national and donor-funded programmes. Her work spans HIV, TB, health systems strengthening, national strategic planning, monitoring and evaluation and implementation science. She has collaborated with UNAIDS, WHO, CDC and the Global Fund.
expertise: Differentiated service delivery and health equity

team.name: Arno Haegens
team.bio: Development communication strategist with more than 25 years of experience across Africa and Southeast Asia, including work with United Nations programmes, governments and international partners. Arno specialises in communication for development, advocacy, public diplomacy and cross-cultural stakeholder engagement.
